Definition: a pipe (for pouring forth, e.g. wine), i.e. the penis
BiblicalUsage: Shophekah names the male member, and it appears once, in the law that bars a man wounded in that way from entering the congregation of the Lord. The verse is blunt, and the law is about wholeness in the assembly, not about shame.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gave laws about the body because the body matters to Him, and this hard one is honest: holiness touched every part of life, even the parts we would rather not name.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
